candidate_new_edges_CANDIDATE_ONLY.definition: tile2net sidewalk/crosswalk/connector length with no OSM sidewalk-or-footway within 5 m; includes false positives (gutters, parking aisles, private drives) and must be human/QA verified before router use

caveat: OpenStreetMap sidewalk data is incomplete and not ground truth; these are proxy metrics, not accuracy. Tile2Net did not train on this region unless in_training_cities is true. candidate_new_edges is CANDIDATE-ONLY (unverified).
